'''2010 Worlds Day 3 Chris Terwilliger DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Terwilliger]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Sheet deck name '''Hunt Down-v'''; starting card on the list is Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost (non-V).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
